answer_1.quote: We comprehensively benchmark representative open-source, closed-source, and text-centric MLLMs on TVQACML.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to visual questions in multilingual settings, which constitutes natural language generation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt chrF for its robustness to spelling variants and morphological diversity in low-resource languages, and define a Custom Binary Accuracy (CBA)... we further incorporate Accuracy (Acc)... and Visual-Textual Similarity (vtS) based on CINO embeddings.

answer_4.quote: To establish an upper-bound reference, we include a human benchmark based on five native-speaking annotators per language; we report both the best individual score (Human_best) and the average (Human_avg).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are tasked with generating five unique and relevant questions, which can be answered using the text within the image. Discrepancies between answers are flagged for further adjudication. Third-party reviewers address ambiguous questions, ensuring a reliable 'raise-then-correct' evaluation for text-image comprehension.
